The expected ordering (passive<udca<static) holds 84% of the time, supporting the qualitative finding. However, the specific combination cannot be definitively verified without knowing the original seed, and static=6.4 is substantially above the median. No fabrication is evident — values are plausible outcomes of the stochastic simulation.
